name: Else
source:
Son of a noble family, Else is Baru and Ruji's childhood friend. He is airheaded, but infectiously cheerful and friendly with a laidback attitude.

[Based on the [URL=http://ignote.net/operetta2/benibana/benibana2/character.html#TabPanel13]official website profile[/URL].]
